QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Key to the Second Tower
QuestInfo.0: #p2161003# promised to stay behind to help others even after his brother was rescued. In order to go to the tower, you must have the #t4032833# that #b#p2161003##k carries.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161003# knows how to make the key, but he's asked you to bring the materials. Defeat #r#o8210001##k or #r#o8210002##k and find enough of the #b#t4000626##k items to make the key.
QuestInfo.2: #p2161003# made you the #t4032833#. Use it to unlock the Roof of the Second Tower, and face the #o8210006#.

0.0: Do you need the #t4032833#? I hear there are a bunch of those #o8210006# monsters in the Second Tower, which are even stronger than #o8840002#. Will you be okay? Heh, sure you will.
0.1: I did get into the Second Tower while looking for my brother, so I know what kind of key you need to unlock the gate. I need different materials for that key, though. Think we can help each other again?

yes.0: Ah, that's the answer I expect from a confident adventurer! Defeat #r#o8210001# and #o8210002#s#k, and bring me #b50#k #b#t4000626#s#k. Can you handle that? Of course you can!

no.0: Then...sorry, but I can't make the key. Even a legendary locksmith like myself needs the right materials.

1.0: You got the #t4000626#s? That was fast! How did you defeat those terrible #o8210001#s? I mean, they didn't just give you the #t4000626#s, right? Of course not. That's stupid. Anyway, give me the #t4000626#s, and I'll make that key.

yes.0: Here's the #t4032833#. I'll make you another one if you lose it. This is kind of fun, actually. My locksmithing business is usually slow, but helping you here is way more exciting!

item.0: You haven't collected #b50 #t4000626#s#k yet? I guess those #r#o8210001#s#k are a tall order...
